column1: # Resource registry — the single source of truth for EVERY cloud resource this
# stack deploys. Pipe-delimited; '#' and blank lines ignored. Columns:
# match_by tells the audit how to identify OUR resources (and ONLY ours):
#   label  — Hetzner label selector; the API returns only matching resources
#   suffix — Cloudflare record name ends with this (nonprod subtree only)
# Because discovery is driven entirely by this list, resources NOT described
# here (e.g. the production server in the same Hetzner project) are never queried
# and never appear. To start managing a new resource, add one line here.
